title: Rental site: make someone an admin
summary: Two sites, same steps: the test site first, then the live site.

lc: Give admin access in the rental site

nodes.text: New staff member logs in once

sections.title: Before you start
sections.text: Both people must be on the UNG network. The new staff member logs in to each site once first, so the system can find them. Lab assistants never make admins.

sections.title: 1. Test site
steps: Search by 900 number or username, then **Add**.
Staff Level **Admin**, **Submit**. Check the list shows Admin. Log out.

sections.title: 2. Live site
steps: Log in to `langlabrentals.ung.edu`, then Staff Interfaces > **Language Lab**.
